messages:
Dylan P: Quick one — I switched from full-time to a 0.8 FTE internal contractor mid-quarter. There was a national holiday (Aug 15) during a mandatory maintenance blackout that I covered. Can I carry that holiday into my new leave year or is it forfeited? cc @People Ops
People Ops: Hi Dylan — short version: entitlement is calculated based on your status at the time of the holiday. Because you were FT earlier in the quarter but 0.8 FTE at the time of blackout we need to pro-rate and confirm which contract/status applied on the blackout date. Please attach your role change notice and manager confirmation.
Dylan P: I switched on Aug 1. The blackout was Aug 14-16. Manager said the rotation required my presence.
People Ops: Okay — that makes the relevant status 0.8 FTE on the blackout date. Policy excerpt: 
```
- Holiday entitlement is determined by employment status on the date of the holiday.
- If statutory/company holiday falls during a mandatory blackout and the employee could not reasonably take it, HR may approve pro-rated carryover or payout. Manager confirmation required.
- Carryover cap: up to 1 statutory day (or equivalent hours) can be carried into next leave year unless local law states otherwise.
```
Maya S: I was Dylan's manager then — can confirm he was scheduled on client coverage and couldn't take the day. Happy to sign. +1 for carryover so he doesn't lose the day.
Dylan P: Thanks Maya. Timeline/how to submit? Payroll is already prepping next run.
People Ops: Submit the `blackout-exception` form here: https://intranet.redwood/hr-forms/blackout-exception and attach Maya's confirmation and the role change note. For payouts, payroll cutoff is 12 business days before the payrun; carryovers don't need payroll cutoff but please submit within 30 days of blackout end. If you need payout this cycle, mark the form "payout" and include payroll run date.
Payroll Bot: FYI — payroll cutoff for Aug adjustments is Jul 28 for contractor cycle. Payouts after cutoff roll to next month.
Dylan P: Submitted the form and attached Maya's note + role change doc. Selected "carryover" and marked urgent because I prefer time off next quarter.
People Ops: Received. Opened case HR-2026-6240. We'll calculate pro-rated hours (0.8 of a day = 0.8 * 8h = 6.4h) and confirm whether we apply as fractional hours or convert to a floating half/full day depending on company policy. Expect an update in 3-5 business days.
calendar-bot: Reminder — maintenance blackout Aug 14-16. See https://calendar.redwood/blackouts
Dylan P: Quick follow-up — if carryover pushes me above the carryover cap because I already have 1 carried statutory day, will HR payout the extra or deny?
People Ops: Good question — if approving would exceed cap we have two options: (1) convert the excess to a one-time payout, or (2) apply as a compensation floating day that sits outside the usual cap for exceptional cases. We'll flag the case and discuss with Payroll. We'll let you know next update.
Dylan P: Great, thanks for the clarity and speed.
People Ops: No problem — closing note: always file within 30 days and include manager confirmation to avoid payroll delays.
